# How to Images to PDF with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to combine multiple images into a single pdf, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_images_to_pdf`

## Prompt

```text
Combine multiple images into a single PDF.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_ids` (required): Input image file id list.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: images-to-pdf-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
